Experience luxurious wellness in a compact footprint with the Maxxus MX‑K356‑01 CED, a premium 3-person corner infrared sauna made from sustainably harvested Canadian Hemlock. Its elegant corner orientation maximizes space while providing generous interior seating for therapeutic heat sessions.

Equipped with nine advanced Carbon PureTech™ near-zero EMF heating panels, this sauna spreads heat across a three-person corner footprint. Oversized chromotherapy lighting and built-in audio options (Bluetooth, FM, USB/SD aux) provide a fully immersive, spa-like atmosphere.

Installation is seamless thanks to its clasp-together design—no tools required—and it plugs into a standard 120 V/20 A outlet (dedicated circuit recommended). Whether placed in a home gym, master bath, or wellness corner, the MX‑K356‑01 CED delivers high-end craftsmanship, holistic comfort, and peace of mind with a 5-year warranty on heating electronics.
